subtitle: High-rise tailored palazzo wide-leg trousers with double front pleats, sharp pressed creases, concealed waist closure, and slant pockets.
closure_type: Concealed Trouser Hook & Bar (Inside Waistband) + Front Fly Zipper
belt_loops_placement: 2 over front main pleats, 2 over pocket tops at side seams, 1 at center back
front_pleats: Double forward pleats per leg (4 total)
crease_lines: Sharp pressed vertical center creases running from main pleats to hem
pockets: Slanted hip pockets (Italian slant pockets) with stay-tape reinforcement
back_construction: 4 waist darts (2 per leg), center back seam, zero back pockets, pocketless clean rear
hem: Deep 5.0 cm (2.0 in) weighted fold-up hem
silhouette: Ultra-Wide Palazzo Leg Sweep (hem circumference 68–74 cm)
recommended_fabric: Washed Linen-Viscose / Tencel Melange (Sand Beige / Oatmeal)

notions.closure: 1x heavy-duty metal trouser hook & bar (concealed inside) + optional 12mm flat inside anchor button
notions.interfacing: 0.40 m medium-weight fusible interfacing for waistband & fly
notions.stay_tape: 0.50 m bias stay-tape for slant pocket edges
notions.thread: 1 spool 100% polyester all-purpose thread matching fabric
